Home.description: My name is Thái Duy Vũ, and a Computer Science Engineer from Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology with over two years of comprehensive experience in fullstack web development. Possessing a strong positive attitude and high energy, I am adept at rapidly learning and effectively applying new technologies, programming languages, frameworks, and libraries. Known for being a collaborative and supportive team member, contributing to a positive and productive work environment. While naturally focused and detail-oriented, which enhances my ability to concentrate deeply on tasks, I am deeply committed to continuous self-improvement through challenging projects. I am confident that my proactive approach, eagerness for growth, and adaptability to technological advancements will enable me to deliver significant value to your organization and team.
